result.summary: Validated src/design/iss-0093-audit-trigger-shim-removal.md (Type E prose design). python tools/lint_design_artefact.py passed clean (0 issues). Independently re-read tests/integration/helpers.zig lines 190-329 and confirmed the proposed diff scope is exact: lines 208-230 contain precisely the GBL-081 stale comment (209-212) and the six DISABLE TRIGGER ALL statements (213-230, process_definitions/instance_projections/tasks/dead_letter_items/webhook_subscriptions/webhook_deliveries) and nothing else; lines 232-318 are structurally unrelated shims (instances compat table, bpm_test_events_compat_defaults trigger on events, bpm_repository_artifacts_immutable triggers on repository_artifacts) referencing different tables/root causes, correctly marked out-of-scope and preserved. Call site (TestHarness.init(), lines 481-484) and execCompatibilitySql() error handling (lines 321-327) match the design's claims verbatim. Spot-checked 3 of the 10 additionally-fixed tests by reading their actual assertions: TC-OBS-03-INT-01/03 (obs03_audit_log_test.zig:180,402) and TC-ADP-06-02 (adp06_pipeline_run_correlation_test.zig:115) each genuinely require one of the six tables' bpm_audit_on_mutation() trigger to fire for their audit_entries assertions to pass -- confirmed by reading the INSERT/query pairs directly, not just trusting the doc. Also confirmed TC-EXT-02-INT-08 (ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig:615) independently. Spot-checked 2 of the 4 confirmed-safe tests: TC-ADP-02-05 (adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig:437) inserts directly into audit_entries, no trigger dependency; xc02_audit_immutability_test.zig uses its own self-contained, properly deferred ALTER TABLE audit_entries DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER USER pair (lines 354-355) scoped to audit_entries itself, unrelated to applyCompatibilityShims(). Verified via migrations/020_obs03_audit_entries.sql, migrations/024_webhook_subscription_audit.sql, migrations/072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql, and migrations/GBL-082_fix_audit_chain_resource_id_text.sql that the trigger-attachment and rename claims are accurate. Design's only code-like block (lines 147-164) is explicitly labeled illustrative pseudocode, not literal Zig -- no implementation code present. Both files_to_change entries from docs/issues/ISS-0093.json (helpers.zig diff shape; audit_iss103_test.zig re-verification + broader risk sweep) are covered. No contradiction found between the design's claims and the actual source; all spot-checks confirmed.
